opening.argument: The presentation actively solicits viewers to purchase 10 STRONG, pay upfront Ethereum gas fees, and create a StrongBlock node as an investment opportunity advertised at 230% APR. It projects recurring income from the initial investment, including approximately $22,000 annually from about $6,700, and characterizes those returns as “fantastic, phenomenal, amazing.” The repeated encouragement to proceed is reinforced by the claim that paying gas fees is worthwhile to get the opportunity rolling. Although it discloses that contributed STRONG is no longer owned directly and can only be recovered through later rewards, that limitation does not offset the central solicitation or the highly emphasized income projections.
